summary: Israeli military sources report ongoing coordination with US forces and potential planning for additional operations in Iran following the 'Zair al-Asad' operation. An Omani pilot confessed to planning a plane crash into Ben Gurion Airport, which was thwarted by an Indian pilot. Tensions remain high across the region with continued cross-border incidents and political developments.
key_points: Israeli military sources confirm continued close intelligence and operational coordination with the US military, with American officers present in Israel and Israeli officers in the US, while also preparing for potential independent action in Iran. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397154)

An Omani pilot admitted in custody to planning to crash a plane into Terminal 3 at Ben Gurion Airport, having waited until Jordan airspace to attack the co-pilot to avoid suspicion, with the plot foiled by an Indian pilot's intervention. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94483)

Israeli Defense Forces confirmed eliminating a Hamas militant who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7 attacks, conducting airstrikes in Khan Younis and killing the individual in a targeted operation. (Source: @idf_telegram/25276)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir marked three years since October 7 with a ceremony at Zikim Base, presenting an award to a Unit 8200 intelligence officer whose pre-attack warnings were previously dismissed by senior intelligence officials. (Source: @idf_telegram/25279)

Israeli aircraft conducted airstrikes in southern Lebanon near the border, with residents reporting explosions, as part of ongoing cross-border tensions between Israel and Hezbollah. (Source: @New_security8200/204088)

Iran's oil minister resigned amid economic pressure and US efforts to block Iranian oil exports through the Hormuz Strait, with American officials claiming success in disrupting Iranian oil revenue streams. (Source: @yediotnews25/135755)

Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps Deputy Commander Brigadier General Ali Fadavi warned that any US or Israeli escalation would be disadvantageous to them, stating Iran has forced US ships to use alternative southern routes through the Hormuz Strait. (Source: @presstv/209496)

The IDF continues operations in Gaza and Lebanon while marking the anniversary of October 7 with ceremonies and intelligence reviews.

sections.threat_assessment: The region faces heightened risks from multiple vectors including potential Israeli military action in Iran, ongoing cross-border incidents with Hezbollah in Lebanon, and continued Hamas infrastructure in Gaza. Aviation security threats have emerged as a critical concern following the thwarted Ben Gurion Airport attack plot. Iranian-backed forces maintain pressure through proxy networks while economic warfare continues to impact Iran's capabilities.
sections.regional_response: Israel has responded to intelligence threats with enhanced aviation security measures and targeted military operations against Hamas elements. The US maintains close coordination with Israeli forces while managing its own regional deployments amid Iranian warnings. European nations have expressed concern over escalatory rhetoric while monitoring Iranian maritime activities in the Hormuz Strait.
sections.intelligence_notes: Pre-attack intelligence warnings were reportedly dismissed by senior Israeli officials prior to October 7, highlighting potential gaps in threat assessment protocols. Coordination between Israeli and US intelligence remains strong despite public tensions, with shared concerns about Iranian regional ambitions. Human intelligence sources and signal intercepts continue to provide critical early warning capabilities across multiple theaters.
